text:
Predicates:
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is Antarctica.
SouthShetlandIslands(x) ::: x is in the South Shetland Islands.
GreenwichIsland(x) ::: x is Greenwich Island.
DeceptionIsland(x) ::: x is Deception Island.
SnowIsland(x) ::: x is Snow Island.
PlaceA(x) ::: x is place A.
PlaceB(x) ::: x is place B.
PlaceC(x) ::: x is place C.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Transit(x, y, z) ::: if x is in y and y is in z, then x is in z.

Premises:
BarutinCove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
SnowIsland, GreenwichIsland, and DeceptionIsland are located in the South Shetland Islands.
Antarctica is located on the South Shetland Islands.
∀x ∀y ∀z ((Transit(x, y, z)) → (Location(x, y) ∧ Location(y, z))) ::: If place x is in y and y is in z, then x is in z.

Conclusion:
¬∃x (Island(x) ∧ LocatedIn(x, Antarctica) ∧ NamedAfter(x, allIslandsInAntarctica)) ::: Barutin Cove is not named after all islands in Antarctica.
